readme.run: Denoise a 2D image, 3D Z-stack or 2D+T time-series
notes: Input is a single-channel TIFF, OME-TIFF, ImageJ TIFF or NIfTI (.nii, .nii.gz) file.
Choose --method fgr-gbdt (default), fgr-ridge, zs-n2n, or vst-nlm.
Pass --residual to also save the noise residual map (input minus denoised).
Add --help for every option: mode, tree count, depth, scale radius, CNN steps/channels, and output format.
No network connection is required and no external pretrained weights are downloaded.
Denoise is research software. Inspect the residual map and autocorrelation diagnostics before quantitative analysis.
Please cite Batson & Royer 2019 (Noise2Self), Royer Lab (Aydin), Mansour & Heckel 2023 (ZS-N2N),
Buades et al. 2005 / Darbon et al. 2008 (NLM), and Makitalo & Foi 2013 / Foi et al. 2008 (GAT).
